answer.summary: Two ArchUnit tests in TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest fail because this change adds direct calls from PayloadVersionService to PayloadIdentityRepository and PayloadIdentity methods, which the architecture rules don't allow. The violations are in the code the PR touches, so a rerun will fail the same way. The flake history shows one of the two tests failed 4x before, but the log points at this change's new calls, not at a race or infrastructure problem.
